evidence: Before the fix, `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k focus` gave 2 failed, 6 passed, 136 deselected. Both failures were test_table_regains_focus_when_a_tab_shows_it_after_an_empty_tab[60] and [120], with AssertionError: assert None is TaskTable(id='tasks'). After the fix, the same command gave 8 passed, 136 deselected. The full `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q` gave 144 passed in 122s.
observations: Pressing 5 (Needs you, empty in the seeded effort) hides #tasks. Pressing 1 (Active) shows #tasks again, but app.focused stays None. Arrow keys and j/k therefore reach no widget, and enter falls through to the app-level open action on row 0. With the fix, the table has focus after the change back to Active, down moves the cursor to row 1 (a task row, not a section), and enter opens TaskDetailScreen for that row's task id.
root_cause: fill_tasks sets table.display = bool(tasks). On an empty tab this hides the focused DataTable, and Textual drops focus to None. select_status_tab repaints and marks the tab but never refocuses. The existing refocus in on_tabbed_content_tab_activated runs only on effort-tab changes, not on status-tab changes. Fix: select_status_tab now calls focus_tasks() after mark_status_tab. focus_tasks focuses only a visible table, and select_status_tab already returns early when an Input has focus.
